# Create base

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Airtable/Working-with-databases/Create-database.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Create base and other functions to work with Airtable in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Airtable]

# Create base
 Creates a new database

`Function CreateDatabase(Val Token, Val Workspace, Val Name, Val TableCollection) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Workspace | --ws | String | &#x2714; | Workspace identifier |
  | Name | --title | String | &#x2714; | New base name |
  | TableCollection | --tablesdata | Map Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Table description: Key > name, Value > array of fields |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Airtable
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token  = "patNn4BXW66Yx3pdj.5b93c53cab554a8387de02d...";
    Region = "wspdf8yl1yZz3PmWZ";
    Name   = "TestDatabase";

    FieldArray = New Array;
    FieldArray.Add(OPI_Airtable.GetNumberField("Number"));
    FieldArray.Add(OPI_Airtable.GetStringField("String"));

    TableName = "TestTable";

    TableMapping = New Map;
    TableMapping.Insert(TableName, FieldArray);

    Result = OPI_Airtable.CreateDatabase(Token, Region, Name, TableMapping);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint airtable CreateDatabase \
              --token "***" \
              --ws "wspdf8yl1yZz3PmWZ" \
              --title "TestDatabase" \
              --tablesdata "{'TestTable':[{'name':'Number','type':'number','options':{'precision':'0'}},{'name':'String','type':'richText'}]}"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint airtable CreateDatabase ^
              --token "***" ^
              --ws "wspdf8yl1yZz3PmWZ" ^
              --title "TestDatabase" ^
              --tablesdata "{'TestTable':[{'name':'Number','type':'number','options':{'precision':'0'}},{'name':'String','type':'richText'}]}"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "id": "appSkDOBxJZFKSwQB",
 "tables": [
  {
   "id": "tbl2VwwLri0gLlE1L",
   "name": "TestTable",
   "primaryFieldId": "fldlGfSKiuJmTvu08",
   "fields": [
    {
     "type": "number",
     "options": {
      "precision": 0
     },
     "id": "fldlGfSKiuJmTvu08",
     "name": "Number"
    },
    {
     "type": "richText",
     "id": "fldp7lcTGB41y3ExF",
     "name": "String"
    }
   ],
   "views": [
    {
     "id": "viwdKW3pVVMcE4l4b",
     "name": "Grid view",
     "type": "grid"
    }
   ]
  }
 ]
}
```

# Create field

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Airtable/Working-with-fields/Create-field.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Create field and other functions to work with Airtable in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Airtable]

# Create field
 Creates a new field in the table

`Function CreateField(Val Token, Val Base, Val Table, Val FieldStructure) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Base | --base | String | &#x2714; | Base identifier |
  | Table | --table | String | &#x2714; | Table identifier |
  | FieldStructure | --fielddata | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Description of the new field |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Airtable
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token = "patNn4BXW66Yx3pdj.5b93c53cab554a8387de02d...";
    Base  = "appJiRrCJhRhnaVAo";
    Table = "tblFGmvh2eldM8MuJ";
    Name  = String(New UUID);

    Field  = OPI_Airtable.GetNumberField(Name);
    Result = OPI_Airtable.CreateField(Token, Base, Table, Field);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint airtable CreateField \
              --token "***" \
              --base "appZ3bojJFizsjQto" \
              --table "tblrDlifP8zqwLc5l" \
              --fielddata "{'name':'bf2c2c51-a286-43bf-9e33-7aefd64c22c3','type':'number','options':{'precision':'0'}}"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint airtable CreateField ^
              --token "***" ^
              --base "appZ3bojJFizsjQto" ^
              --table "tblrDlifP8zqwLc5l" ^
              --fielddata "{'name':'bf2c2c51-a286-43bf-9e33-7aefd64c22c3','type':'number','options':{'precision':'0'}}"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "type": "number",
 "options": {
  "precision": 0
 },
 "id": "fldPYNBDMkCVTdwFe",
 "name": "51365be3-abde-4ce9-8f8b-2790546cb8e1"
}
```

# Modify field
 Changes the name and/or description of an existing table field

`Function ModifyField(Val Token, Val Base, Val Table, Val Field, Val Name = "", Val Description = "") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Base | --base | String | &#x2714; | Base identifier Base |
  | Table | --table | String | &#x2714; | Table identifier |
  | Field | --field | String | &#x2714; | Field identifier |
  | Name | --title | String | &#x2716; | New name |
  | Description | --description | String | &#x2716; | New description |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Airtable
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token = "patNn4BXW66Yx3pdj.5b93c53cab554a8387de02d...";
    Base  = "appJiRrCJhRhnaVAo";
    Table = "tblFGmvh2eldM8MuJ";
    Field = "fldm9baY6FkgCPaCi";

    Name        = String(New UUID) + "(change.)";
    Description = "New description";

    Result = OPI_Airtable.ModifyField(Token, Base, Table, Field, Name, Description);
```

# Create calendar event

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Calendar-events-management/Create-calendar-event.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Create calendar event and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Create calendar event
 Creates a new calendar event

`Function CreateCalendarEvent(Val URL, Val EventDescription, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | EventDescription | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Event description. See GetCalendarEventsStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [calendar.event.add](https://apidocs.bitrix24.ru/api-reference/calendar/calendar-event/calendar-event-add.html)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL        = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    CalendarID = "1648";

    Tomorrow = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate() + 86400;
    Hour     = 3600;

    EventStucture = New Structure;

    EventStucture.Insert("type"         , "user");
    EventStucture.Insert("ownerId"      , 1);
    EventStucture.Insert("from"         , OPI_Tools.GetXMLString(Tomorrow));
    EventStucture.Insert("to"           , OPI_Tools.GetXMLString(Tomorrow + Hour));
    EventStucture.Insert("section"      , CalendarID);
    EventStucture.Insert("name"         , "New event");
    EventStucture.Insert("skip_time"    , "N");
    EventStucture.Insert("timezone_from", "Europe/Minsk");
    EventStucture.Insert("timezone_to"  , "Europe/Minsk");
    EventStucture.Insert("description"  , "Event description");
    EventStucture.Insert("color"        , "%23000000>");
    EventStucture.Insert("text_color"   , "%23FFFFFF");
    EventStucture.Insert("accessibility", "quest");
    EventStucture.Insert("importance"   , "normal");
    EventStucture.Insert("private_event", "Y");

    RepeatabilityStructure = New Structure;
    RepeatabilityStructure.Insert("FREQ"    , "DAILY");
    RepeatabilityStructure.Insert("COUNT"   , 3);
    RepeatabilityStructure.Insert("INTERVAL", 10);

    DaysArray = New Array;
    DaysArray.Add("SA");
    DaysArray.Add("MO");

    RepeatabilityStructure.Insert("BYDAY", DaysArray);
    RepeatabilityStructure.Insert("UNTIL", (Tomorrow + Hour * 24 * 10));

    EventStucture.Insert("rrule"     , RepeatabilityStructure);
    EventStucture.Insert("is_meeting", "Y");
    EventStucture.Insert("location"  , "Office");

    RemindersArray = New Array;

    ReminderStructure = New Structure;
    ReminderStructure.Insert("type" , "day");
    ReminderStructure.Insert("count", 1);

    RemindersArray.Add(ReminderStructure);

    EventStucture.Insert("remind"   , RemindersArray);
    EventStucture.Insert("attendees", StrSplit("1,10", ","));
    EventStucture.Insert("host"     , 1);

    MeetingStructure = New Structure;
    MeetingStructure.Insert("notify"      , "Y");
    MeetingStructure.Insert("reinvite"    , "Y");
    MeetingStructure.Insert("allow_invite", "N");
    MeetingStructure.Insert("hide_guests" , "N");

    EventStucture.Insert("meeting", MeetingStructure);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateCalendarEvent(URL, EventStucture);

    URL        = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token      = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    CalendarID = "1650";

    EventStucture.Insert("section", CalendarID);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateCalendarEvent(URL, EventStucture, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash

              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --fields "{'type':'user','ownerId':'1','from':'06/19/2026 16:22:27','to':'06/19/2026 17:22:27','section':'2808','name':'New event','skip_time':'N','timezone_from':'Europe/Minsk','timezone_to':'Europe/Minsk','description':'Event description','color':'%23000000>','text_color':'%23FFFFFF','accessibility':'quest','importance':'normal','private_event':'Y','rrule':{'FREQ':'DAILY','COUNT':'3','INTERVAL':'10','BYDAY':['SA','MO'],'UNTIL':'06/29/2026 16:22:27'},'is_meeting':'Y','location':'Office','remind':[{'type':'day','count':'1'}],'attendees':['1','10'],'host':'1','meeting':{'notify':'Y','reinvite':'***','allow_invite':'***','hide_guests':'N'}}" \

        ```

# Get calendar events

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Calendar-events-management/Get-calendar-events.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Get calendar events and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Get calendar events
 Gets events of calendars with or without filters

`Function GetCalendarEvents(Val URL, Val OwnerID, Val Type, Val Filter = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | OwnerID | --owner | String, Number | &#x2714; | Calendar owner ID |
  | Type | --type | String | &#x2714; | Calendar type: user, group, company_calendar |
  | Filter | --filter | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Events filter. See GetCalendarEventsFilterStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [calendar.event.get](https://apidocs.bitrix24.ru/api-reference/calendar/calendar-event/calendar-event-get.html)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL     = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    OwnerID = 1;
    Type    = "user";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetCalendarEvents(URL, OwnerID, Type);

    URL         = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token       = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    EventID     = "3046";
    CalendarID1 = "1648";
    CalendarID2 = "1650";

    Tomorrow = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate() + 86400;
    NextDay  = Tomorrow + 86400;

    ArrayOfCalendars = New Array;
    ArrayOfCalendars.Add(CalendarID1);
    ArrayOfCalendars.Add(CalendarID2);

    Filter = New Structure;
    Filter.Insert("from"   , Tomorrow);
    Filter.Insert("to"     , NextDay);
    Filter.Insert("section", ArrayOfCalendars);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetCalendarEvents(URL, OwnerID, Type, Filter, Token);
```

# Update calendar event
 Modifies calendar event data

`Function UpdateCalendarEvent(Val URL, Val EventID, Val EventDescription, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | EventID | --event | Number | &#x2714; | Calednar event ID |

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL     = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    EventStucture.Insert("type"         , "user");

    EventStucture.Insert("description"  , "New event description");
    EventStucture.Insert("importance"   , "low");
    EventStucture.Insert("private_event", "Y");

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateCalendarEvent(URL, EventID, EventStucture);

    URL        = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token      = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    EventID    = "3046";
    CalendarID = "1650";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateCalendarEvent(URL, EventID, EventStucture, Token);
```

# Create calendar

description: Create calendar and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Create calendar
 Creates a new calendar

`Function CreateCalendar(Val URL, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Calendar fields structure. See GetCalendarStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [calendar.section.add](https://apidocs.bitrix24.ru/api-reference/calendar/calendar-section-add.html)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    UserID = 1;

    CalendarsStructure = New Structure;
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("type"       , "user");
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("ownerId"    , UserID);
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("name"       , "new calendar");
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("description", "My new calendar");
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("color"      , "#FFFFFF");
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("text_color" , "#000000");

    ExportStructure = New Structure;
    ExportStructure.Insert("ALLOW", "True");
    ExportStructure.Insert("SET"  , "all");

    CalendarsStructure.Insert("export", ExportStructure);

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateCalendar(URL, CalendarsStructure);

    CalendarsStructure.Insert("name"       , "Another calendar");
    CalendarsStructure.Insert("description", "My other new calendar");

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateCalendar(URL, CalendarsStructure, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateCalendar \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --fields "{'type':'user','ownerId':'1','name':'Another calendar','description':'My other new calendar','color':'#FFFFFF','text_color':'#000000','export':{'ALLOW':'True','SET':'all'}}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateCalendar ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^

              --token "***"
        ```

# Get user busy

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Calendars-management/Get-user-busy.mdx

sidebar_position: 5

description: Get user busy and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Get user busy
 Gets an array of user events in the specified interval

`Function GetUserBusy(Val URL, Val Users, Val StartDate, Val EndDate, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Users | --users | Number, Array Of Number | &#x2714; | IDs of users or a single user |
  | StartDate | --from | Date | &#x2714; | Start date of the period |
  | EndDate | --to | Date | &#x2714; | End date of the period |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [calendar.accessibility.get](https://apidocs.bitrix24.ru/api-reference/calendar/calendar-accessibility-get.html)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL        = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    CalendarID = "1648";

    User = 1;

    Week        = 604800;
    CurrentDate = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate();

    StartDate = CurrentDate;
    EndDate   = CurrentDate + Week;

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetUserBusy(URL, User, StartDate, EndDate);

    URL        = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token      = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    CalendarID = "1650";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetUserBusy(URL, User, StartDate, EndDate, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 GetUserBusy \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --users 1 \
              --from "2026-06-18T16:22:42" \
              --to "2026-06-25T16:22:42" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 GetUserBusy ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --users 1 ^
              --from "2026-06-18T16:22:42" ^
              --to "2026-06-25T16:22:42" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Edit calendar
 Changes the calendar settings

`Function UpdateCalendar(Val URL, Val CalendarID, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | CalendarID | --calendar | String, Number | &#x2714; | Calendar ID |

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL        = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
```

# Create chat

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Chats-and-dialogs-management/Create-chat.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Create chat and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Create chat
 Creates a new chat based on the field structure

`Function CreateChat(Val URL, Val ChatStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | ChatStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Chat fields structure. See GetChatStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [im.chat.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/learning/course/?COURSE_ID=93&LESSON_ID=12093)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Image = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg";
    OPI_TypeConversion.GetBinaryData(Image);

    B64Image = GetBase64StringFromBinaryData(Image);

    MembersArray = New Array;
    MembersArray.Add(10);
    MembersArray.Add(1);

    ChatStructure = New Structure;
    ChatStructure.Insert("TYPE"       , "OPEN");
    ChatStructure.Insert("TITLE"      , "New chat");
    ChatStructure.Insert("DESCRIPTION", "This is a new chat");
    ChatStructure.Insert("COLOR"      , "GREEN");
    ChatStructure.Insert("MESSAGE"    , "Welcome to new chat");
    ChatStructure.Insert("USERS"      , MembersArray);
    ChatStructure.Insert("AVATAR"     , B64Image);
    ChatStructure.Insert("OWNER_ID"   , 1);

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateChat(URL, ChatStructure);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    ChatStructure = New Structure;
    ChatStructure.Insert("TYPE" , "CHAT");
    ChatStructure.Insert("TITLE", "Private chat");
    ChatStructure.Insert("USERS", MembersArray);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateChat(URL, ChatStructure, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateChat \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --fields "{'TYPE':'CHAT','TITLE':'Private chat','USERS':['10','1']}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateChat ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --fields "{'TYPE':'CHAT','TITLE':'Private chat','USERS':['10','1']}" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "result": 7210,
```

# Add custom task field
 Adds a new custom field to be added to the task

`Function AddCustomTaskField(Val URL, Val Type, Val Name, Val ExternalID = "", Val Title = "", Val Signature = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Type | --type | String | &#x2714; | Field type: string, double, date, boolean |
  | Name | --fieldname | String | &#x2714; | Text identifier (name) of the field |
  | ExternalID | --externalid | String | &#x2716; | Text identifier for external integration |
  | Title | --title | String | &#x2716; | Field title |
  | Signature | --label | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Form label. Key: en or ru, Value: Lable text |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Type       = "string";
    Name       = "TEXT_FIELD";
    ExternalID = "BITRIX_TEXT_FIELD";
    Title      = "Text field";
    Signature  = New Structure("en,ru", "Some field", "Nekotoroe pole");
```

description: Update custom task field and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Update custom task field
 Updates a custom task field data

`Function UpdateCustomTaskField(Val URL, Val FieldID, Val ExternalID = "", Val Title = "", Val Signature = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FieldID | --fieldid | String, Number | &#x2714; | Field ID for updating |
  | ExternalID | --externalid | String | &#x2716; | Text identifier for external integration |
  | Title | --title | String | &#x2716; | Field title |
  | Signature | --label | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Form label. Key: en or ru, Value: Lable text |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.item.userfield.update](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/userfield/update.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    FieldID = "259";
    Title   = "New title";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateCustomTaskField(URL, FieldID, , Title);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    FieldID    = "261";
    ExternalID = "NEW_TEXT_FIELD";
    Signature  = New Structure("en,ru", "Updated field", "Izmenennoe pole");

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateCustomTaskField(URL, FieldID, ExternalID, , Signature, Token);
```

# Create deal
 Creates a new deal by field structure

`Function CreateDeal(Val URL, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Deal fields structure. See. GetDealStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [crm.deal.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/crm/cdeals/crm_deal_add.php)

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    FieldsStructure = New Structure;
    FieldsStructure.Insert("TITLE"         , "Planned sale");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("TYPE_ID"       , "GOODS");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("STAGE_ID"      , "NEW");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("COMPANY_ID"    , 1);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CONTACT_ID"    , 3);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("OPENED"        , "Y");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("ASSIGNED_BY_ID", 1);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("PROBABILITY"   , 30);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CURRENCY_ID"   , "USD");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("OPPORTUNITY"   , 5000);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CATEGORY_ID"   , 5);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("BEGINDATE"     , "2024-01-01");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CLOSEDATE"     , "2030-01-01");

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateDeal(URL, FieldsStructure);

    FieldsStructure.Insert("TITLE"    , "Another deal");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CLOSEDATE", "2031-01-01");

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateDeal(URL, FieldsStructure, Token);
```

# Get deals list

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Deals-management/Get-deals-list.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Get deals list and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Get deals list
 Gets the list of deals (50 pcs per query max) with or without filtering

`Function GetDealsList(Val URL, Val Filter = "", Val Indent = 0, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Filter | --filter | Structure of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Deals filter structure. See GetDealsFilterStructure |
  | Indent | --offset | Number, String | &#x2716; | Offset from the beginning of the list to retrieve deals > 50 pcs recursively |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [crm.deal.list](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/crm/cdeals/crm_deal_list.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetDealsList(URL);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Filter = New Structure;
    Filter.Insert("TITLE"      , "Sale in RUB");
    Filter.Insert("CURRENCY_ID", "RUB");

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetDealsList(URL, Filter, , Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 GetDealsList \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --filter "{'TITLE':'Sale in RUB','CURRENCY_ID':'RUB'}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 GetDealsList ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --filter "{'TITLE':'Sale in RUB','CURRENCY_ID':'RUB'}" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Update deal
 Modifies an existing deal

`Function UpdateDeal(Val URL, Val DealID, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | DealID | --deal | Number, String | &#x2714; | Deal ID |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Deal fields structure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    FieldsStructure = New Structure;
    FieldsStructure.Insert("TITLE"      , "Sale in RUB");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("CURRENCY_ID", "RUB");

    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateDeal(URL, DealID, FieldsStructure);

    FieldsStructure.Insert("BEGINDATE", "2025-01-01");

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateDeal(URL, DealID, FieldsStructure, Token);
```

        ```bash
              --token "***"
        ```

# Create post
 Create a new post at news feed

`Function CreatePost(Val URL, Val Text, Val Visibility = "UA", Val Files = "", Val Title = "", Val Important = False, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Text | --text | String | &#x2714; | Text of post |
  | Visibility | --vision | String | &#x2716; | Array or 1 recipient: UA all, SGn w. group, Un user, DRn department, Gn group |
  | Files | --files | Map Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Key > file name, value > path or binary data |
  | Title | --title | String | &#x2716; | Post title |
  | Important | --important | Boolean | &#x2716; | Mark post as important |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [log.blogpost.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/log/log_blogpost_add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Text   = "Text of post";
    Title  = "Post title";
    Image1 = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg"; // URL, Path or Binary data
    Image2 = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg"; // URL, Path or Binary data

    Files = New Map;
    Files.Insert("1.png", Image1);
    Files.Insert("2.png", Image2);

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreatePost(URL, Text, , Files, Title, True);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreatePost(URL, Text, , Files, Title, , Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreatePost \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --text "Text of post" \
              --files "{'1.png':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg','2.png':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg'}" \
              --title "Post title" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file

              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --text "Text of post" ^

              --title "Post title" ^

        ```

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Image1 = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg"; // URL, Path or Binary data
    PostID = "3326";

    Files = New Map;
    Files.Insert("1.png", Image1);

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdatePost(URL, PostID, Text, , Files, Title);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    PostID = "3324";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdatePost(URL, PostID, Text, , Files, Title, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 UpdatePost \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --postid 4488 \
              --text "New post text" \
              --files "{'1.png':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg'}" \
              --title "New post title" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 UpdatePost ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --postid 4488 ^
              --text "New post text" ^
              --files "{'1.png':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg'}" ^
              --title "New post title" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Upload file to the folder
 Upload local file to the folder

`Function UploadFileToFolder(Val URL, Val Name, Val File, Val FolderID, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Name | --title | String | &#x2714; | File name with extension |
  | File | --file | String, BinaryData | &#x2714; | File for upload |
  | FolderID | --folderid | String | &#x2714; | Folder identifier |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UploadFileToFolder(URL, Name, Image, DestinationID, Token);
```

# Add kanban stage
 Add new stage of kanban or My Plan

`Function AddKanbanStage(Val URL, Val Name, Val Color = "FFD800", Val PrevStageID = 0, Val EntityID = 0, Val AsAdmin = False, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Name | --title | String | &#x2714; | New stage name |
  | Color | --color | String | &#x2716; | HEX of new stage color |
  | PrevStageID | --prevstage | String, Number | &#x2716; | ID of the stage after which a new stage should be inserted (at the beginning by default.) |
  | EntityID | --entityid | String, Number | &#x2716; | ID of kanban owner (group or user) |
  | AsAdmin | --admin | Boolean | &#x2716; | Allows you to add stages without checking permissions (for administrators) |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.stages.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/kanban/task_stages_add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Name  = "New stage";
    Color = "0026FF";

    Name  = "New stage 2";
    Color = "0026FF";

    URL         = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token       = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    PrevStageID = Result["result"];

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.AddKanbanStage(URL, Name, Color, PrevStageID, , True, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash

              --token "***"
        ```

# Change kanban stage
 Changes the properties of the existing kanban or My plan stage

`Function UpdateKanbansStage(Val URL, Val Name, Val StageID, Val Color = "", Val PrevStageID = 0, Val AsAdmin = False, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Name | --title | String | &#x2714; | New stages name |
  | StageID | --stage | String, Number | &#x2714; | Stage ID for change |
  | Color | --color | String | &#x2716; | HEX of new stage color |
  | PrevStageID | --prevstage | String, Number | &#x2716; | Stage ID, after which the selected stage should be inserted |
  | AsAdmin | --admin | Boolean | &#x2716; | Allows you to add stages without checking permissions (for administrators) |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.stages.update](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/kanban/task_stages_update.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Name    = "New stage name";
    Color   = "000000";
    StageID = "3216";

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateKanbansStage(URL, Name, StageID, Color);

    Name    = "New stage name 2";
    Color   = "000000";
    StageID = "3218";

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateKanbansStage(URL, Name, StageID, Color, 6, True, Token);
```

# Create lead

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Leads-management/Create-lead.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Create lead and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Create lead
 Creates a new lead by fields structure

`Function CreateLead(Val URL, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Lead fields structure. See GetLeadStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [crm.lead.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/crm/leads/crm_lead_add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    EmailsArray = New Array;
    EmailsArray.Add(New Structure("VALUE,VALUE_TYPE", "yo@example.com", "HOME"));
    EmailsArray.Add(New Structure("VALUE,VALUE_TYPE", "hi@example.com", "WORK"));

    PhonesArray = New Array;
    PhonesArray.Add(New Structure("VALUE,VALUE_TYPE", "88005553535", "WORK"));

    FieldsStructure = New Structure;
    FieldsStructure.Insert("ADDRESS"        , "Pushkin st., b. 10");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("ADDRESS_COUNTRY", "Russia");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("EMAIL"          , EmailsArray);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("NAME"           , "John");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("LAST_NAME"      , "Doe");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("PHONE"          , PhonesArray);
    FieldsStructure.Insert("TITLE"          , "MegaClient");

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateLead(URL, FieldsStructure);

    FieldsStructure.Insert("NAME"     , "Ivan");
    FieldsStructure.Insert("LAST_NAME", "Ivanov");

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateLead(URL, FieldsStructure, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateLead \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --fields "{'ADDRESS':'Pushkin st., b. 10','ADDRESS_COUNTRY':'Russia','EMAIL':[{'VALUE':'yo@example.com','VALUE_TYPE':'HOME'},{'VALUE':'hi@example.com','VALUE_TYPE':'WORK'}],'NAME':'Ivan','LAST_NAME':'Ivanov','PHONE':[{'VALUE':'88005553535','VALUE_TYPE':'WORK'}],'TITLE':'MegaClient'}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateLead ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --fields "{'ADDRESS':'Pushkin st., b. 10','ADDRESS_COUNTRY':'Russia','EMAIL':[{'VALUE':'yo@example.com','VALUE_TYPE':'HOME'},{'VALUE':'hi@example.com','VALUE_TYPE':'WORK'}],'NAME':'Ivan','LAST_NAME':'Ivanov','PHONE':[{'VALUE':'88005553535','VALUE_TYPE':'WORK'}],'TITLE':'MegaClient'}" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Get leads list

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Leads-management/Get-leads-list.mdx

description: Get leads list and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Get leads list
 Gets a list of leads (50 per request max) with or without filtering

`Function GetLeadsList(Val URL, Val Filter = "", Val Indent = 0, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Filter | --filter | Structure of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Lead filter structure. See GetLeadFilterStructure |
  | Indent | --offset | Number, String | &#x2716; | Offset from the beginning of the list to get leads > 50 recursively |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [crm.lead.list](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/crm/leads/crm_lead_list.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetLeadsList(URL);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Filter = New Structure;
    Filter.Insert("TITLE"    , "MegaClient");
    Filter.Insert("HAS_EMAIL", "Y");

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetLeadsList(URL, Filter, , Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
        ```

# Edit message
 Edit dialog message content

`Function EditMessage(Val URL, Val MessageID, Val Text = "", Val Attachments = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | MessageID | --message | String, Number | &#x2714; | ID of the message to be edited |
  | Text | --text | String | &#x2716; | New message text |
  | Attachments | --blocks | Array of Structure | &#x2716; | New blocks array |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [im.message.update](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/learning/course/?COURSE_ID=93&LESSON_ID=12117)

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL       = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.EditMessage(URL, MessageID, Text);

    URL       = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token     = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    MessageID = "67536";

    Image = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bayselonarrend/OpenIntegrations/main/service/test_data/picture.jpg";
    File  = "https://github.com/Bayselonarrend/OpenIntegrations/raw/main/service/test_data/document.docx";

    Attachments = New Array;
    Attachments.Add(OPI_Bitrix24.GetPictureBlock("Image1"  , Image));

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.EditMessage(URL, MessageID, Text, Attachments, Token);
```

# Send file

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Message-management/Send-file.mdx

sidebar_position: 5

description: Send file and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Send file
 Send disk file to chat

`Function SendFile(Val URL, Val ChatID, Val FileID, Val Description = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | ChatID | --chat | String, Number | &#x2714; | Chat ID |
  | FileID | --fileid | String, Number | &#x2714; | File ID from UploadFileToFolder method |
  | Description | --description | String | &#x2716; | File description |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [im.disk.file.commit](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/learning/course/index.php?COURSE_ID=93&LESSON_ID=11485)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL         = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    ChatID      = "3390";
    File        = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/document.docx"; // Binary data, URL or path to file
    Description = "Very important file";

    Directory = OPI_Bitrix24.GetChatFilesFolder(URL, ChatID);
    FolderID  = Directory["result"]["ID"];

    UploadedFile = OPI_Bitrix24.UploadFileToFolder(URL, "Imortant doc.docx", File, FolderID);
    FileID       = UploadedFile["result"]["ID"];

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.SendFile(URL, ChatID, FileID, Description);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    ChatID = "3392";

    Directory = OPI_Bitrix24.GetChatFilesFolder(URL, ChatID, Token);
    FolderID  = Directory["result"]["ID"];

    UploadedFile = OPI_Bitrix24.UploadFileToFolder(URL, "Imortant doc.docx", File, FolderID, Token);
    FileID       = UploadedFile["result"]["ID"];

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.SendFile(URL, ChatID, FileID, Description, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 SendFile \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --chat "***" \
              --fileid 62068 \
              --description "Very important file" \
              --token "***"
        ```

        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 SendFile ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --chat "***" ^
              --fileid 62068 ^
              --description "Very important file" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Send message
 Send message to dialog

`Function SendMessage(Val URL, Val ChatID, Val Text, Val Attachments = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | ChatID | --chat | String, Number | &#x2714; | Chat ID (as chatXXX) or User ID (as XXX) |
  | Text | --text | String | &#x2714; | Message text |
  | Attachments | --blocks | Array of Structure | &#x2716; | Array of attachments |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [im.message.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/learning/course/?COURSE_ID=93&LESSON_ID=12115)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    ChatID = "3390";

    OPI_TypeConversion.GetLine(ChatID);

    ChatString = "chat" + ChatID;
    Text       = "Message text";
    Image      = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Bayselonarrend/OpenIntegrations/main/service/test_data/picture.jpg";
    File       = "https://github.com/Bayselonarrend/OpenIntegrations/raw/main/service/test_data/document.docx";

    Attachments = New Array;
    Attachments.Add(OPI_Bitrix24.GetPictureBlock("Image1"  , Image));
    Attachments.Add(OPI_Bitrix24.GetFileBlock("File1.docx" , File));

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.SendMessage(URL, ChatString, Text, Attachments);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    UserID = 10;

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.SendMessage(URL, UserID, Text, , Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 SendMessage \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --chat "***" \
              --text "Message text" \
              --token "***"
        ```

        ```batch
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --chat "***" ^
              --text "Message text" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Attach file to the topic
 Attaches a file to the selected task

`Function AttachFileToTopic(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val FileID, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | FileID | --fileid | Number, String | &#x2714; | File ID |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.files.attach](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_files_attach.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";
    FileID = "46668";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.AttachFileToTopic(URL, TaskID, FileID);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.AttachFileToTopic(URL, TaskID, FileID, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 AttachFileToTopic \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --fileid 62032 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 AttachFileToTopic ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --fileid 62032 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Check task accesses for users
 Checks the availability of the task for users

`Function CheckTaskAccesses(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val Users = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | Users | --users | Array of String | &#x2716; | User IDs for access checking |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.getaccess](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_getaccess.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ArrayOfUsers = New Array;
    ArrayOfUsers.Add("1");
    ArrayOfUsers.Add("10");

    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CheckTaskAccesses(URL, TaskID, ArrayOfUsers);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CheckTaskAccesses(URL, TaskID, ArrayOfUsers, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 CheckTaskAccesses \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --users "['1','10']" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 CheckTaskAccesses ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --users "['1','10']" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Create task

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Create-task.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Create task and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Create task
 Create new task by fields structure

`Function CreateTask(Val URL, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Task fields structure. See GetTaskFieldsStructure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    // The complete structure of the fields can be obtained by the GetTaskFieldsStructure() function()

    CurrentDate = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate();
    Hour        = 3600;
    Day         = 24;
    Responsible = 1;

    TaskData = New Structure;
    TaskData.Insert("TITLE"         , "New task");
    TaskData.Insert("DESCRIPTION"   , "New task description");
    TaskData.Insert("PRIORITY"      , "2");
    TaskData.Insert("DEADLINE"      , CurrentDate + Hour * Day);
    TaskData.Insert("RESPONSIBLE_ID", Responsible);

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateTask(URL, TaskData);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateTask(URL, TaskData, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateTask \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --fields "{'TITLE':'New task','DESCRIPTION':'New task description','PRIORITY':'2','DEADLINE':'06/19/2026 16:12:41','RESPONSIBLE_ID':'1'}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 CreateTask ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --fields "{'TITLE':'New task','DESCRIPTION':'New task description','PRIORITY':'2','DEADLINE':'06/19/2026 16:12:41','RESPONSIBLE_ID':'1'}" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Create tasks dependencies

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Create-tasks-dependencies.mdx

description: Create tasks dependencies and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Create tasks dependencies
 Creates the dependency of one task to another

`Function CreateTasksDependencies(Val URL, Val FromID, Val DestinationID, Val LinkType, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FromID | --taskfrom | String, Number | &#x2714; | From task ID |
  | DestinationID | --taskto | String, Number | &#x2714; | To task ID |
  | LinkType | --linktype | String, Number | &#x2714; | Link type: 0 start>start, 1 start>finish, 2 finish>start, 3 finish>finish |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.dependence.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/dependence/task_dependence_add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    FromID        = "8718";
    DestinationID = "8720";
    LinkType      = 0;

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateTasksDependencies(URL, FromID, DestinationID, LinkType);

    FromID        = "8720";
    DestinationID = "8718";
    LinkType      = 2;

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.CreateTasksDependencies(URL, FromID, DestinationID, LinkType, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 CreateTasksDependencies \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --taskfrom "11648" \
              --taskto "11646" \
              --linktype 2 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 CreateTasksDependencies ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --taskfrom "11648" ^
              --taskto "11646" ^
              --linktype 2 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Defer task
 Defer task by ID

`Function DeferTask(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.defer](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_defer.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DeferTask(URL, TaskID);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DeferTask(URL, TaskID, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 DeferTask \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 DeferTask ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Delegate task
 Delegate task to another user

`Function DelegateTask(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val UserID, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | UserID | --user | Number, String | &#x2714; | ID of responsible user |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.delegate](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_delegate.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";
    UserID = "2960";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DelegateTask(URL, TaskID, UserID);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DelegateTask(URL, TaskID, UserID, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 DelegateTask \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --user 2960 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 DelegateTask ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --user 2960 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Delete tasks dependencies

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Delete-tasks-dependencies.mdx

sidebar_position: 24

description: Delete tasks dependencies and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Delete tasks dependencies
 Removes the dependency of one task to another

`Function DeleteTasksDependencies(Val URL, Val FromID, Val DestinationID, Val LinkType, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | FromID | --taskfrom | String, Number | &#x2714; | From task ID |
  | DestinationID | --taskto | String, Number | &#x2714; | To task ID |
  | LinkType | --linktype | String, Number | &#x2714; | Link type: 0 start>start, 1 start>finish, 2 finish>start, 3 finish>finish |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.dependence.delete](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/dependence/task_dependence_delete.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    FromID        = "8718";
    DestinationID = "8720";
    LinkType      = 0;

    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DeleteTasksDependencies(URL, FromID, DestinationID, LinkType);

    FromID        = "8720";
    DestinationID = "8718";
    LinkType      = 2;

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.DeleteTasksDependencies(URL, FromID, DestinationID, LinkType, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 DeleteTasksDependencies \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --taskfrom "11648" \
              --taskto "11646" \
              --linktype 2 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 DeleteTasksDependencies ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --taskfrom "11648" ^
              --taskto "11646" ^
              --linktype 2 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "result": [],
 "time": {
  "start": 1781804481,
  "finish": 1781804481.88195,
  "duration": 0.881952047348022,
  "processing": 0,
  "date_start": "2026-06-18T17:41:21+00:00",
  "date_finish": "2026-06-18T17:41:21+00:00",
  "operating_reset_at": 1781805081,
  "operating": 0
```

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |

# Get structure of tasks filter

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Get-tasks-filter-structure.mdx

sidebar_position: 27

description: Get structure of tasks filter and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Get structure of tasks filter
 Return filter structure for GetTasksList

`Function GetTasksFilterStructure(Val Clear = False, Val AsMap = False) Export`

  | Clear | --empty | Boolean | &#x2716; | True > structure with empty valuse, False > field descriptions at values |
  | AsMap | --map | Boolean | &#x2716; | True > returns the filter fields as a map |

 Structure Of KeyAndValue - Fields structure
  

:::tip
Returning fields as a map allows you to specify the filtering type before the filtered field name

Types of filtration: !, &lt;, &lt;=, &gt;, &gt;=. For example: !ID:3 (ID not equal to 3)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Clear  = False;
    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetTasksFilterStructure(Clear);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 GetTasksFilterStructure \
              --empty false
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 GetTasksFilterStructure ^
              --empty false
        ```

# Get tasks list

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Get-tasks-list.mdx

sidebar_position: 2

description: Get tasks list and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Get tasks list
 Get tasks list (50 at one response max) with or without filtering

`Function GetTasksList(Val URL, Val Filter = "", Val Indent = 0, Val Token = "", Val Fields = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | Filter | --filter | Structure of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Lead filter structure. See GetLeadFilterStructure |
  | Indent | --offset | Number, String | &#x2716; | Offset of tasks list |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |
  | Fields | --select | String, Array of String | &#x2716; | A list of task fields in the response. All non calculable by default |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.list](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_list.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    CurrentDate = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate();

    // Full filter structure you can find at GetTasksFilterStructure method
    Filter = New Map;
    Filter.Insert("CREATED_BY", 1); // Producer with ID 1
    Filter.Insert("!RESPONSIBLE_ID", 10); // Performers with ID not equal to 10
    Filter.Insert(">=CREATED_DATE ", CurrentDate - 60 * 60 * 24); // Creation date >= yesterday

    Fields = New Array;
    Fields.Add("UF_CRM_TASK");
    Fields.Add("CREATED_BY");

    Indent = 1;
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetTasksList(URL, Filter, , , Fields);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetTasksList(URL, , Indent, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 GetTasksList \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --offset 1 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 GetTasksList ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --offset 1 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Mute task

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Mute-task.mdx

sidebar_position: 21

description: Mute task and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Mute task
 Mute task by ID

`Function MuteTask(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.mute](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/mute_unmute.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.MuteTask(URL, TaskID);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.MuteTask(URL, TaskID, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 MuteTask \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 MuteTask ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Update task

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Tasks-management/Update-task.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Update task and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Update task
 Update a task

`Function UpdateTask(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val FieldsStructure, Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | Number, String | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | FieldsStructure | --fields | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Task fields structure |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [tasks.task.update](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/tasks/tasks_task_update.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    // The complete structure of the fields can be obtained by the GetTaskFieldsStructure() function()

    TaskData = New Structure;
    TaskData.Insert("TITLE"      , "Another task title");
    TaskData.Insert("DESCRIPTION", "Another task description");
    TaskData.Insert("PRIORITY"   , "1");

    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8718";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateTask(URL, TaskID, TaskData);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    TaskID = "8720";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateTask(URL, TaskID, TaskData, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 UpdateTask \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11648" \
              --fields "{'TITLE':'Another task title','DESCRIPTION':'Another task description','PRIORITY':'1'}" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint bitrix24 UpdateTask ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11648" ^
              --fields "{'TITLE':'Another task title','DESCRIPTION':'Another task description','PRIORITY':'1'}" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Add task time accounting

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Timekeeping/Add-task-time-accounting.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Add task time accounting and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, Bitrix24]

# Add task time accounting
 Adds information about the user's time spent to the task

`Function AddTaskTimeAccounting(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val Time, Val UserID = "", Val Text = "", Val SetupDate = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | String, Number | &#x2714; | ID of task for time accounting |
  | Time | --amount | String, Number | &#x2714; | Time spent in seconds |
  | UserID | --user | String, Number | &#x2716; | ID of user for time accounting |
  | Text | --text | String | &#x2716; | Comment text |
  | SetupDate | --date | String | &#x2716; | Date the record was set |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.elapseditem.add](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/elapseditem/add.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL    = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID = "8726";

    Time = 3600;

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.AddTaskTimeAccounting(URL, TaskID, Time);

    URL   = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";

    Text      = "Time spent on work";
    UserID    = 10;
    Time      = 7200;
    SetupDate = AddMonth(OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate(), -1);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.AddTaskTimeAccounting(URL
        , TaskID
        , Time
        , UserID
        , Text
        , SetupDate
        , Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 AddTaskTimeAccounting \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11654" \
              --amount 7200 \
              --user 10 \
              --text "Time spent on work" \
              --date "2026-05-18T16:18:01" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 AddTaskTimeAccounting ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11654" ^
              --amount 7200 ^
              --user 10 ^
              --text "Time spent on work" ^
              --date "2026-05-18T16:18:01" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

`Function GetTimekeepingSettings(Val URL, Val UserID = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | UserID | --userid | String, Number | &#x2716; | Users ID. Current by default |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [timeman.settings](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/timeman/base/timeman_settings.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetTimekeepingSettings(URL);

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    UserID = 1;

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.GetTimekeepingSettings(URL, UserID, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 GetTimekeepingSettings \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --userid 1 \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 GetTimekeepingSettings ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --userid 1 ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Start timekeeping

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/Bitrix24/Timekeeping/Start-timekeeping.mdx

description: Start timekeeping and other functions to work with Bitrix24 in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Start timekeeping
 Starts user timekeeping

`Function StartTimekeeping(Val URL, Val UserID = "", Val Time = "", Val Report = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | UserID | --userid | String, Number | &#x2716; | Users ID. Current by default |
  | Time | --time | Date | &#x2716; | Start time. The date must match the current. Current time by default. |
  | Report | --report | String | &#x2716; | Reason for change. Required when Time is specified and free schedule is disabled |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [timeman.open](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/timeman/base/timeman_open.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.StartTimekeeping(URL);

    Hour = 3600;

    URL    = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token  = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    UserID = 1;
    Time   = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate() - Hour;
    Report = "Late";

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.StartTimekeeping(URL, UserID, Time, Report, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 StartTimekeeping \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --userid 1 \
              --time "2026-06-18T15:18:15" \
              --report "Late" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 StartTimekeeping ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --userid 1 ^
              --time "2026-06-18T15:18:15" ^
              --report "Late" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

# Stop timekeeping
 Stops user timekeeping

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | UserID | --userid | String, Number | &#x2716; | Users ID. Current by default |
  | Time | --time | Date | &#x2716; | Stop time. The date must match the current. Current time by default. |
  | Report | --report | String | &#x2716; | Reason for change. Required when Time is specified and free schedule is disabled |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API

# Update task time accounting

# Update task time accounting
 Update time accounting record data

`Function UpdateTaskTimeAccounting(Val URL, Val TaskID, Val RecordID, Val Time, Val Text = "", Val SetupDate = "", Val Token = "") Export`

  | URL | --url | String | &#x2714; | URL of webhook or a Bitrix24 domain, when token used |
  | TaskID | --task | String, Number | &#x2714; | Task ID |
  | RecordID | --record | String, Number | &#x2714; | Time record ID |
  | Time | --amount | String, Number | &#x2714; | Time spent in seconds |
  | Text | --text | String | &#x2716; | Comment text |
  | SetupDate | --date | String | &#x2716; | Date the record was set |
  | Token | --token | String | &#x2716; | Access token, when app auth method used |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON of answer from Bitrix24 API
  

:::tip
Method at API documentation: [task.elapseditem.update](https://dev.1c-bitrix.ru/rest_help/tasks/task/elapseditem/update.php)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    URL      = "https://b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by/rest/1/av5...";
    TaskID   = "8726";
    RecordID = "3202";

    Text = "The text I forgot last time";
    Time = 4800;

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateTaskTimeAccounting(URL, TaskID, RecordID, Time, Text);

    URL      = "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by";
    Token    = "a5b00469006e9f06006b12e400000001000...";
    RecordID = "3204";

    Text      = "New time record";
    Time      = 4800;
    SetupDate = AddMonth(OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate(), -1);

    Result = OPI_Bitrix24.UpdateTaskTimeAccounting(URL, TaskID, RecordID, Time, Text, SetupDate, Token);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint bitrix24 UpdateTaskTimeAccounting \
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" \
              --task "11654" \
              --record 4366 \
              --amount 4800 \
              --text "New time record" \
              --date "2026-05-18T16:18:09" \
              --token "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint bitrix24 UpdateTaskTimeAccounting ^
              --url "b24-ar17wx.bitrix24.by" ^
              --task "11654" ^
              --record 4366 ^
              --amount 4800 ^
              --text "New time record" ^
              --date "2026-05-18T16:18:09" ^
              --token "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "result": null,
 "time": {
  "start": 1781804660,
```
