# Execute custom command

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/Common-methods/Execute-custom-command.mdx

sidebar_position: 7

description: Execute custom command and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Execute custom command
 Executes a specific (SITE) server command and returns the response

`Function ExecuteCustomCommand(Val Connection, Val CommandText) Export`

  | Connection | --conn | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | CommandText | --cmd | String | &#x2714; | Text of the executed command |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
The result can be returned as text or Base64 binary data in the structure `{"BYTES": &lt;B64 string&gt;}`

FTP Command: `SITE`
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then

        CommandText = "UMASK";
        Result      = OPI_FTP.ExecuteCustomCommand(Connection, CommandText);

    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp ExecuteCustomCommand \
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" \
              --cmd "UMASK"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file

              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" ^
              --cmd "UMASK"
        ```


# Get connection configuration

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/Common-methods/Get-connection-configuration.mdx

sidebar_position: 2

description: Get connection configuration and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Get connection configuration
 Forms a complete structure of connection settings that can be used instead of the actual connection when calling other functions

`Function GetConnectionConfiguration(Val FTPSettings, Val Proxy = Undefined, Val Tls = Undefined) Export`

  | FTPSettings | --set | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | FTP settings. See GetConnectionSettings |
  | Proxy | --proxy | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | Proxy settings, if required. See GetProxySettings |
  | Tls | --tls | Structure Of KeyAndValue | &#x2716; | TLS settings, if necessary. See GetTlsSettings |

 Structure Of KeyAndValue - Connection settings structure
  

:::tip
Can be passed as the `Connection` parameter in other functions instead of the actual connection from the `CreateConnection` function. At the same time, a new connection will be opened and closed within the called function

Using the connection configuration is not recommended for multiple requests to the FTP server. This functionality is primarily intended for the CLI version of OInt, where maintaining a connection between calls is not possible
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Result = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionConfiguration(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp GetConnectionConfiguration \
              --set "{'domain':'172.33.0.11','port':'21','passive':true,'read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120','advanced_resolve':true,'login':'bayselonarrend','password':'***'}" \
              --proxy "{'server':'127.0.0.1','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','login':'proxyuser','password':'***'}" \
              --tls "{'use_tls':true,'accept_invalid_certs':true}"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp GetConnectionConfiguration ^
              --set "{'domain':'172.33.0.11','port':'21','passive':true,'read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120','advanced_resolve':true,'login':'bayselonarrend','password':'***'}" ^
              --proxy "{'server':'127.0.0.1','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','login':'proxyuser','password':'***'}" ^
              --tls "{'use_tls':true,'accept_invalid_certs':true}"
        ```


# Get connection settings

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/Common-methods/Get-connection-settings.mdx

sidebar_position: 12

description: Get connection settings and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Get connection settings
 Creates a structure of FTP connection settings

`Function GetConnectionSettings(Val Host, Val Port = 21, Val Login = Undefined, Val Password = Undefined, Val Passive = True, Val ReadTimeout = 120, Val WriteTimeout = 120, Val IPResolve = True) Export`

  | Host | --host | String | &#x2714; | Host address |
  | Port | --port | Number | &#x2716; | Server port |
  | Login | --login | String, Undefined | &#x2716; | Username for authorization, if required |
  | Password | --pass | String, Undefined | &#x2716; | User password for authorization, if required |
  | Passive | --passive | Boolean | &#x2716; | Passive connection mode |
  | ReadTimeout | --rtout | Number | &#x2716; | Read timeout |
  | WriteTimeout | --wtout | Number | &#x2716; | Write timeout |
  | IPResolve | --ipresl | Boolean | &#x2716; | Advanced passive mode address resolution |

 Structure Of KeyAndValue - Connection settings structure
  

:::tip
When `IPResolve = True`, the connection address returned by the server in passive mode after `PASV` will be replaced with the IP from the `Host` field, in cases when a proxy is used or the server returns `127.0.0.1` (only if an IP address is specified in the `Host` field))
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    Result = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint ftp GetConnectionSettings \
              --host "172.33.0.11" \
              --port 21 \
              --login "bayselonarrend" \
              --pass "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint ftp GetConnectionSettings ^
              --host "172.33.0.11" ^
              --port 21 ^
              --login "bayselonarrend" ^
              --pass "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "domain": "172.33.0.11",
 "port": 21,
 "passive": "***",
 "read_timeout": 120,
 "write_timeout": 120,
 "advanced_resolve": true,
 "login": "bayselonarrend",
 "password": "***"
}
```

# Get log

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/Common-methods/Get-log.mdx

sidebar_position: 16
sidebar_class_name: doc-no-cli
description: Get log  and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Get log 
 Retrieves connection log data (when in-memory logging is enabled)

`Function GetLog(Val Connection, Val AsString = False, Val EventCount = 100) Export`

  | Connection | - | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | AddIn object with open connection |
  | AsString | - | Boolean | &#x2716; | True > returns log as a single string, False > as an array |
  | EventCount | - | Number | &#x2716; | Number of recent events to retrieve. 0 > no limits |

 String, Map Of KeyAndValue - Log as a string or a map with the full execution result
  

*This method has no additional advanced call parameters.*

<Admonition type="caution" title="Caution" className="nocli-admonition">
<div className="addin">
<strong>NOCLI:</strong> this method is not available in CLI version
</Admonition>

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    LogFile         = GetTempFileName("txt");
    LoggingSettings = OPI_FTP.GetLoggingSettings(True, 100, LogFile);

    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined;

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http";

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings, LoggingSettings);

    If Not OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then
        Raise OPI_Tools.JSONString(Connection);
    EndIf;

    Result = OPI_FTP.Ping(Connection);

    Result = OPI_FTP.GetLog(Connection);
```
 

```json title="Result"
{
 "logs": [
  "[2026-06-18 17:45:53.977] Connecting to FTP...",
  "[2026-06-18 17:45:54.016] Connected to FTP",
  "[2026-06-18 17:45:54.626] Closing FTP connection"
 ],
 "result": true,
 "returned": 3,
 "total": 3
}
```

# Get object size
 Get the size of a file or directory if it exists

`Function GetObjectSize(Val Connection, Val Path) Export`

  | Connection | --conn | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | Path | --path | String | &#x2714; | Path to the object |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
FTP Command: `SIZE`
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then
        Result = OPI_FTP.GetObjectSize(Connection, "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png");
    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```

 Changes the object's path to the specified one

`Function UpdatePath(Val Connection, Val Path, Val NewPath) Export`

  | Connection | --conn | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | Path | --old | String | &#x2714; | Current path to object |
  | NewPath | --new | String | &#x2714; | New path to object |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
The ability to move an object from one directory to another by changing the path depends on the server settings

FTP Command: `RNFR + RNTO`
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then
        Result = OPI_FTP.UpdatePath(Connection, "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png", "new_dir/pic_copy.png");
    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp UpdatePath \
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" \
              --old "new_dir/pic_copy.png" \
              --new "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp UpdatePath ^
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" ^
              --old "new_dir/pic_copy.png" ^
              --new "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "result": true
}
```

`Function ChangeCurrentDirectory(Val Connection, Val Path) Export`

  | Connection | - | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | Path | - | String | &#x2714; | Path to new directory |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
```

# Get file data

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/File-management/Get-file-data.mdx

sidebar_position: 4
sidebar_class_name: doc-no-cli
description: Get file data  and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Get file data 
 Gets file from server as binary data

`Function GetFileData(Val Connection, Val Path) Export`

  | Connection | - | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | Path | - | String | &#x2714; | Path to file on server |

 Map Of KeyAndValue, BinaryData - File data or error information
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
FTP Command: `RETR`
:::

<Admonition type="caution" title="Caution" className="nocli-admonition">
<div className="addin">
<strong>NOCLI:</strong> this method is not available in CLI version
</Admonition>

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then

        Path   = "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png";
        Result = OPI_FTP.GetFileData(Connection, Path);

    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```
 

```json title="Result"
"<Binary data>"
```

# Save file

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/File-management/Save-file.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Save file and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Save file
 Saves the file from the server to the specified path

`Function SaveFile(Val Connection, Val Path, Val FileName) Export`

  | Connection | --conn | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | Path | --path | String | &#x2714; | Path to file on server |
  | FileName | --file | String | &#x2714; | Path to save file on disk |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
FTP Command: `RETR`
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then

        Path     = "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png";
        FileName = GetTempFileName("bin");

        Result = OPI_FTP.SaveFile(Connection, Path, FileName);

    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp SaveFile \
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" \
              --path "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png" \
              --file "/tmp/tnvw53md.gzt.bin"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp SaveFile ^
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'120','write_timeout':'120'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" ^
              --path "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png" ^
              --file "/tmp/tnvw53md.gzt.bin"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "bytes": 2114023,
 "filepath": "/tmp/1j3vkcds.v5l.bin",
 "result": true
}
```

# Upload file

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/FTP/File-management/Upload-file.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Upload file and other functions to work with FTP in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, FTP]

# Upload file
 Uploads a file from disk or binary data to the FTP server

`Function UploadFile(Val Connection, Val File, Val Path) Export`

  | Connection | --conn | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | Existing connection or connection configuration |
  | File | --file | String, BinaryData | &#x2714; | File on disk or file data |
  | Path | --path | String | &#x2714; | Path to save file on server |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Processing result
  

  | addin_mode | Manual selection of external component connection mode (for 1C): Isolated, NotIsolated |

:::tip
FTP Command: `STOR`

Parameters with Binary data type can also accept file paths on disk and URLs
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ImagePath = "C:\pic.png";

    ImageDD = New BinaryData(Image);

    Host     = "172.33.0.10";
    Port     = "21";
    Login    = "bayselonarrend";
    Password = "12we...";

    UseProxy = True;
    FTPS     = True;

    ProxySettings = Undefined;
    TLSSettings   = Undefined; // FTPS

    FTPSettings = OPI_FTP.GetConnectionSettings(Host, Port, Login, Password, , 1000, 1000);

    If UseProxy Then

        ProxyType = "http"; // http, socks5, socks4

        ProxyAddress  = "127.0.0.1";
        ProxyPort     = "8071";
        ProxyLogin    = "proxyuser";
        ProxyPassword = "12we...";

        ProxySettings = OPI_FTP.GetProxySettings(ProxyAddress, ProxyPort, ProxyType, ProxyLogin, ProxyPassword);

    EndIf;

    If FTPS Then
        TLSSettings = OPI_FTP.GetTLSSettings(True);
    EndIf;

    Connection = OPI_FTP.CreateConnection(FTPSettings, ProxySettings, TLSSettings);

    If OPI_FTP.IsConnector(Connection) Then

        Result  = OPI_FTP.UploadFile(Connection, Image, "new_dir/pic_from_disk.png");
        Result2 = OPI_FTP.UploadFile(Connection, ImageDD, "pic_from_binary.png");

    Else
        Result = Connection; // Error of connection
    EndIf;
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp UploadFile \
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'1000','write_timeout':'1000'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" \
              --file "/tmp/w1s3qyr4.1sm" \
              --path "pic_from_binary.png"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint ftp UploadFile ^
              --conn "{'set':{'advanced_resolve':true,'domain':'172.33.0.11','login':'bayselonarrend','passive':true,'password':'***','port':'21','read_timeout':'1000','write_timeout':'1000'},'tls':{'accept_invalid_certs':true,'ca_cert_path':'','use_tls':true},'proxy':{'login':'proxyuser','password':'***','port':'1080','proxy_type':'socks5','server':'127.0.0.1'}}" ^
              --file "/tmp/w1s3qyr4.1sm" ^
              --path "pic_from_binary.png"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "bytes": 2114023,
 "result": true
}
```

# Generate code retrieval link

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleCalendar/Authorization/Form-code-retrieval-link.mdx

description: Generate code retrieval link and other functions to work with GoogleCalendar in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI

# Generate code retrieval link
 Returns URL for browser authorization

`Function FormCodeRetrievalLink(Val ClientID, Val Calendar = True, Val Drive = True, Val Sheets = True) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | Calendar | --calendar | Boolean | &#x2716; | Calendar methods permission |
  | Drive | --drive | Boolean | &#x2716; | Drive methods permission |
  | Sheets | --sheets | Boolean | &#x2716; | Sheets methods permission |

 String - Code retrieval link
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    Result   = OPI_GoogleCalendar.FormCodeRetrievalLink(ClientID);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gcalendar FormCodeRetrievalLink \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gcalendar FormCodeRetrievalLink ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com"
        ```

```json title="Result"
"https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth?response_type=code&client_id=345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr4..."
```

# Get service account token

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleCalendar/Authorization/Get-service-account-token.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Get service account token and other functions to work with GoogleCalendar in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleCalendar]

# Get service account token
 Gets authorization token by service account data

`Function GetServiceAccountToken(Val Data, Val Scope, Val Expire = 3600) Export`

  | Data | --auth | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | JSON authorization data as a file, collection or binary data |
  | Scope | --scope | Array Of String | &#x2714; | Scope or array of scopes |
  | Expire | --exp | Number | &#x2716; | Token lifetime in seconds |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

:::tip
List of available scopes: [developers.google.com](https:

developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/scopes)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Data = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/secret_test_data/google_service.json"; // URL, binary Data, file or collection

    Scope = New Array;
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets");

    Result = OPI_GoogleCalendar.GetServiceAccountToken(Data, Scope);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gcalendar GetServiceAccountToken \
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" \
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gcalendar GetServiceAccountToken ^
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" ^
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "access_token": "***",
 "expires_in": 3599,
 "token_type": "***"
}
```

# Get token by code

# Get token by code
 Gets token by code from browser authorization

`Function GetTokenByCode(Val ClientID, Val ClientSecret, Val Code) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | ClientSecret | --secret | String | &#x2714; | Client secret |
  | Code | --code | String | &#x2714; | Code from browser |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID     = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    ClientSecret = "GOCSPX-v--MJyEjtV...";
    Code         = "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg";

    Result = OPI_GoogleCalendar.GetTokenByCode(ClientID, ClientSecret, Code);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gcalendar GetTokenByCode \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" \
              --secret "***" \
              --code "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gcalendar GetTokenByCode ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" ^
              --secret "***" ^
              --code "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg"
        ```

```json title="Result"

 "error": "invalid_grant",
 "error_description": "Bad Request"
}
```

# Refresh token

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleCalendar/Authorization/Refresh-token.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Refresh token and other functions to work with GoogleCalendar in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleCalendar]

# Refresh token
 Updates token by Refresh token

`Function RefreshToken(Val ClientID, Val ClientSecret, Val RefreshToken) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | ClientSecret | --secret | String | &#x2714; | Client secret |
  | RefreshToken | --refresh | String | &#x2714; | Refresh token |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID     = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    ClientSecret = "GOCSPX-v--MJyEjtV...";
    RefreshToken = "1//09J8_kLVO7HENCgYIARAAGAkSNwF-L9IrtySthNY3OrNP5Qu...";

    Result = OPI_GoogleCalendar.RefreshToken(ClientID, ClientSecret, RefreshToken);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gcalendar RefreshToken \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" \
              --secret "***" \
              --refresh "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gcalendar RefreshToken ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" ^
              --secret "***" ^
              --refresh "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "access_token": "***",
 "expires_in": 3599,
 "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive https://www.googleapi...",
 "token_type": "***"
}
```

# Edit list calendar

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleCalendar/Calendar-list-management/Edit-list-calendar.mdx

# Edit list calendar
 Edits the properties of a calendar from the user's list

`Function EditListCalendar(Val Token, Val Calendar, Val PrimaryColor, Val SecondaryColor, Val Hidden = False) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Calendar | --calendar | String | &#x2714; | Calendar ID |
  | PrimaryColor | --primary | String | &#x2714; | HEX primary color (#ffffff) |
  | SecondaryColor | --secondary | String | &#x2714; | HEX secondary color (#ffffff) |
  | Hidden | --hidden | Boolean | &#x2716; | Hidden calendar |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token          = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Calendar       = "f70efec034ef36b040f12b5d8938e54fc399d73cd37b8e765bdd86ebc4a67e4a@group.calendar.google.com";
    PrimaryColor   = "#000000";
    SecondaryColor = "#ffd800";
    Hidden         = False;

    Result = OPI_GoogleCalendar.EditListCalendar(Token, Calendar, PrimaryColor, SecondaryColor, Hidden);
```
 

  

# Create event

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleCalendar/Event-management/Create-event.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Create event and other functions to work with GoogleCalendar in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleCalendar]

# Create event
 Creates a new event

`Function CreateEvent(Val Token, Val Calendar, Val EventDescription) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Calendar | --calendar | String | &#x2714; | Calendar ID |
  | EventDescription | --props | Map Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Event description |

 String, Arbitrary, HTTPResponse, BinaryData, Undefined - Google server response
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    CurrentDate = OPI_Tools.GetCurrentDate();
    Token       = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Calendar    = "f70efec034ef36b040f12b5d8938e54fc399d73cd37b8e765bdd86ebc4a67e4a@group.calendar.google.com";
    Name        = "New event";
    Description = "TestEventDescription";
    Hour        = 3600;

    Image1      = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg"; // URL, Binary or File path
    Image2      = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg"; // URL, Binary or File path
    Attachments = New Map;

    Attachments.Insert("Image1", Image1);
    Attachments.Insert("Image2", Image2);

    EventDescription = New Map;
    EventDescription.Insert("Description"          , Description);
    EventDescription.Insert("Title"                , Name);
    EventDescription.Insert("Venue"                , "InOffice");
    EventDescription.Insert("StartDate"            , CurrentDate);
    EventDescription.Insert("EndDate"              , EventDescription["StartDate"] + Hour);
    EventDescription.Insert("ArrayOfAttachmentURLs", Attachments);
    EventDescription.Insert("SendNotifications"    , True);

    Result = OPI_GoogleCalendar.CreateEvent(Token, Calendar, EventDescription);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gcalendar CreateEvent \
              --token "***" \
              --calendar "7331cbc26d4a90a544a80a115d2213d26309b8d657760dd54372b2156cd42bd0@group.calendar.google.com" \
              --props "{'Description':'TestEventDescription','Title':'New event','Venue':'InOffice','StartDate':'06/18/2026 16:12:31','EndDate':'06/18/2026 17:12:31','ArrayOfAttachmentURLs':{'Image1':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg','Image2':'https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg'},'SendNotifications':true}"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gcalendar CreateEvent ^
        ```

`Function EditEvent(Val Token, Val Calendar, Val EventDescription, Val Event) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Calendar | --calendar | String | &#x2714; | Calendar ID |
  | EventDescription | --props | String | &#x2714; | New event description |
  | Event | --event | String | &#x2714; | Event ID |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token       = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
```

# Get service account token

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleDrive/Authorization/Get-service-account-token.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Get service account token and other functions to work with GoogleDrive in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleDrive]

# Get service account token
 Gets authorization token by service account data

`Function GetServiceAccountToken(Val Data, Val Scope, Val Expire = 3600) Export`

  | Data | --auth | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | JSON authorization data as a file, collection or binary data |
  | Scope | --scope | Array Of String | &#x2714; | Scope or array of scopes |
  | Expire | --exp | Number | &#x2716; | Token lifetime in seconds |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

:::tip
List of available scopes: [developers.google.com](https:

developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/scopes)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Data = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/secret_test_data/google_service.json"; // URL, binary Data, file or collection

    Scope = New Array;
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets");

    Result = OPI_GoogleDrive.GetServiceAccountToken(Data, Scope);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gdrive GetServiceAccountToken \
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" \
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gdrive GetServiceAccountToken ^
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" ^
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```

sidebar_position: 10

description: Get file description and other functions to work with GoogleDrive in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleDrive]

# Get file description
 Gets a blank description template for uploading a file

`Function GetFileDescription(Val Clear = False) Export`

  | Clear | --empty | Boolean | &#x2716; | True > structure with empty valuse, False > field descriptions at values |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - File description
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Result = OPI_GoogleDrive.GetFileDescription();
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gdrive GetFileDescription \
              --empty false
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gdrive GetFileDescription ^
              --empty false
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "MIME": "image/jpeg",
 "Name": "New file.jpg",
 "Description": "This is a new file",
 "Parent": "root"
}
```

# Get list of files

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleDrive/File-and-directory-management/Get-files-list.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Get list of files and other functions to work with GoogleDrive in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleDrive]

# Get list of files
 Gets the list of files

`Function GetFilesList(Val Token, Val NameContains = "", Val Directory = "") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | NameContains | --query | String | &#x2716; | Filter by name |
  | Directory | --catalog | String | &#x2716; | Filter by parent directory ID |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - Array of file mappings
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token        = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Directory    = "root";
    NameContains = "data";

    Result = OPI_GoogleDrive.GetFilesList(Token, NameContains, Directory);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gdrive GetFilesList \
              --token "***" \
              --query "data" \
              --catalog "root"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gdrive GetFilesList ^
              --token "***" ^
              --query "data" ^
              --catalog "root"
        ```

# Update file

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleDrive/File-and-directory-management/Update-file.mdx

sidebar_position: 8

description: Update file and other functions to work with GoogleDrive in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleDrive]

# Update file
 Updates file binary data

`Function UpdateFile(Val Token, Val Identifier, Val File, Val NewName = "") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Identifier | --object | String | &#x2714; | Identifier of the object to update |
  | File | --file | BinaryData, String | &#x2714; | File source for update |
  | NewName | --title | String | &#x2716; | New file name (if necessary) |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

:::tip
Parameters with Binary data type can also accept file paths on disk and URLs
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token      = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    NewName    = "UpdatedFile.jpg";
    Identifier = "1oUMoSImbl8NKBVWQE9zkBdJ0QIPrkhtb";
    File       = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg"; // URL, Binary data or File path

    Result = OPI_GoogleDrive.UpdateFile(Token, Identifier, File, NewName);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gdrive UpdateFile \
              --token "***" \
              --object "1ikMxR7qdOpVO7Wli1UONI8xv82N70Hbr" \
              --file "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg" \
              --title "UpdatedFile.jpg"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gdrive UpdateFile ^
              --token "***" ^
              --object "1ikMxR7qdOpVO7Wli1UONI8xv82N70Hbr" ^
              --file "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture2.jpg" ^
              --title "UpdatedFile.jpg"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "kind": "drive#file",
 "id": "1Ny7ubs8cnfzmLp5mStiJs6ENEtGk_s3k",
 "name": "UpdatedFile.jpg",
 "mimeType": "image/jpeg"
}
```

# Upload file

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleDrive/File-and-directory-management/Upload-file.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Upload file and other functions to work with GoogleDrive in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleDrive]

# Upload file
 Uploads a file to the drive

`Function UploadFile(Val Token, Val File, Val Description) Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | File | --file | BinaryData, String | &#x2714; | File to be uploaded |
  | Description | --props | Map Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | See GetFileDescription |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

:::tip
Parameters with Binary data type can also accept file paths on disk and URLs
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token     = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Directory = "1RA5EV-HEr2SDzooZLmZ2h6HnnmZ0EHzP";
    Image     = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg"; // URL, Binary data or File path

    Clear       = False;
    Description = OPI_GoogleDrive.GetFileDescription(Clear);

    Description.Insert("Parent", Directory);

    Result = OPI_GoogleDrive.UploadFile(Token, Image, Description);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gdrive UploadFile \
              --token "***" \
              --file "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg" \
              --props "{'MIME':'image/jpeg','Name':'New file.jpg','Description':'This is a new file','Parent':'1T61ve0vc7hRiV8RYiMcBqR0GH3umkYDN'}"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gdrive UploadFile ^
              --token "***" ^
              --file "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/test_data/picture.jpg" ^
              --props "{'MIME':'image/jpeg','Name':'New file.jpg','Description':'This is a new file','Parent':'1T61ve0vc7hRiV8RYiMcBqR0GH3umkYDN'}"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "kind": "drive#file",
 "id": "1ABYOjKFqqi5Fp4hn8QtW_Jr4awezNoQX",
 "name": "New file.jpg",
 "mimeType": "image/jpeg"
}
```

# Generate code retrieval link

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Authorization/Form-code-retrieval-link.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Generate code retrieval link and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Generate code retrieval link
 Returns URL for browser authorization

`Function FormCodeRetrievalLink(Val ClientID, Val Calendar = True, Val Drive = True, Val Sheets = True) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | Calendar | --calendar | Boolean | &#x2716; | Calendar methods permission |
  | Drive | --drive | Boolean | &#x2716; | Drive methods permission |
  | Sheets | --sheets | Boolean | &#x2716; | Sheets methods permission |

 String - Code retrieval link
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    Result   = OPI_GoogleSheets.FormCodeRetrievalLink(ClientID);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gsheets FormCodeRetrievalLink \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gsheets FormCodeRetrievalLink ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com"
        ```

```json title="Result"
"https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth?response_type=code&client_id=345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr4..."
```

# Get service account token

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Authorization/Get-service-account-token.mdx

sidebar_position: 4

description: Get service account token and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Get service account token
 Gets authorization token by service account data

`Function GetServiceAccountToken(Val Data, Val Scope, Val Expire = 3600) Export`

  | Data | --auth | Arbitrary | &#x2714; | JSON authorization data as a file, collection or binary data |
  | Scope | --scope | Array Of String | &#x2714; | Scope or array of scopes |
  | Expire | --exp | Number | &#x2716; | Token lifetime in seconds |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

:::tip
List of available scopes: [developers.google.com](https:

developers.google.com/identity/protocols/oauth2/scopes)
:::

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Data = "https://hut.openintegrations.dev/secret_test_data/google_service.json"; // URL, binary Data, file or collection

    Scope = New Array;
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive");
    Scope.Add("https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets");

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.GetServiceAccountToken(Data, Scope);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gsheets GetServiceAccountToken \
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" \
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gsheets GetServiceAccountToken ^
              --auth "{'type':'service_account','project_id':'openintegrations','private_key_id':'***','private_key':'***','client_email':'***','client_id':'***','auth_uri':'https://accounts.google.com/o/oauth2/auth','token_uri':'***','auth_provider_x509_cert_url':'https://www.googleapis.com/oauth2/v1/certs','client_x509_cert_url':'***','universe_domain':'googleapis.com'}" ^
              --scope "['https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive','https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets']"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "access_token": "***",
 "expires_in": 3599,
 "token_type": "***"
}
```

# Get token by code

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Authorization/Get-token-by-code.mdx

sidebar_position: 2

description: Get token by code and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Get token by code
 Gets token by code from browser authorization

`Function GetTokenByCode(Val ClientID, Val ClientSecret, Val Code) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | ClientSecret | --secret | String | &#x2714; | Client secret |
  | Code | --code | String | &#x2714; | Code from browser |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID     = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    ClientSecret = "GOCSPX-v--MJyEjtV...";
    Code         = "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg";

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.GetTokenByCode(ClientID, ClientSecret, Code);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gsheets GetTokenByCode \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" \
              --secret "***" \
              --code "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gsheets GetTokenByCode ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" ^
              --secret "***" ^
              --code "4/0AeaYSHBDZAbAtChyjMxPKa0DXIilJYYcVCgKYzA_CPmCPSt1mg_KqxI4w5CP3lTlYibpGg"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "error": "invalid_grant",
 "error_description": "Bad Request"
}
```

# Refresh token

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Authorization/Refresh-token.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Refresh token and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Refresh token
 Updates token by Refresh token

`Function RefreshToken(Val ClientID, Val ClientSecret, Val RefreshToken) Export`

  | ClientID | --id | String | &#x2714; | Client ID |
  | ClientSecret | --secret | String | &#x2714; | Client secret |
  | RefreshToken | --refresh | String | &#x2714; | Refresh token |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    ClientID     = "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com";
    ClientSecret = "GOCSPX-v--MJyEjtV...";
    RefreshToken = "1//09J8_kLVO7HENCgYIARAAGAkSNwF-L9IrtySthNY3OrNP5Qu...";

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.RefreshToken(ClientID, ClientSecret, RefreshToken);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gsheets RefreshToken \
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" \
              --secret "***" \
              --refresh "***"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gsheets RefreshToken ^
              --id "345925493105-641q49rl4oflrtr46fkgqf5upiltr4bg.apps.googleusercontent.com" ^
              --secret "***" ^
              --refresh "***"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "access_token": "***",
 "expires_in": 3599,
 "scope": "https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive https://www.googleapi...",
 "token_type": "***"
}
```

# Clear cells

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Data-management/Clear-cells.mdx

sidebar_position: 2

description: Clear cells and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Clear cells
 Clears the value in cells

`Function ClearCells(Val Token, Val Spreadsheet, Val CellsArray, Val Sheet = "") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Spreadsheet | --spreadsheet | String | &#x2714; | SpreadsheetID |
  | CellsArray | --cells | Array of String | &#x2714; | Array of cells like A1 to be cleared |
  | Sheet | --sheetname | String | &#x2716; | Sheet name (first sheet by default) |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token       = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Spreadsheet = "1hAKnTEvhiX-_-fYfXXYthJ3xq6Ub4SrlLPaIg0Tb9fs";
    Sheet       = "Sheet2";

    CellsArray = New Array;
    CellsArray.Add("B2");
    CellsArray.Add("A3");
    CellsArray.Add("B4");

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.ClearCells(Token, Spreadsheet, CellsArray, Sheet);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gsheets ClearCells \
              --token "***" \
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" \
              --cells "['B2','A3','B4']" \
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gsheets ClearCells ^
              --token "***" ^
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" ^
              --cells "['B2','A3','B4']" ^
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "spreadsheetId": "1kHreJuNfTyzvCMLQ9xxhJm5Zx2vLwT6W7A3sNh9g1xU",
 "clearedRanges": [
  "Sheet2!B2",
  "Sheet2!A3",
  "Sheet2!B4"
 ]
}
```

# Get cell values

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Data-management/Get-cell-values.mdx

sidebar_position: 3

description: Get cell values and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Get cell values
 Gets cell values of the table

`Function GetCellValues(Val Token, Val Spreadsheet, Val CellsArray = "", Val Sheet = "") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Spreadsheet | --spreadsheet | String | &#x2714; | SpreadsheetID |
  | CellsArray | --cells | Array of String | &#x2716; | Array of A1 type cells to get (whole sheet if not filled) |
  | Sheet | --sheetname | String | &#x2716; | Sheet name (first sheet by default) |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token       = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Spreadsheet = "1hAKnTEvhiX-_-fYfXXYthJ3xq6Ub4SrlLPaIg0Tb9fs";
    Sheet       = "Sheet2";

    CellsArray = New Array;
    CellsArray.Add("B2");
    CellsArray.Add("A3");
    CellsArray.Add("B4");

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.GetCellValues(Token, Spreadsheet, CellsArray, Sheet);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            oint gsheets GetCellValues \
              --token "***" \
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" \
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            oint gsheets GetCellValues ^
              --token "***" ^
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" ^
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```

```json title="Result"
{
 "spreadsheetId": "1kHreJuNfTyzvCMLQ9xxhJm5Zx2vLwT6W7A3sNh9g1xU",
 "valueRanges": [
  {
   "range": "Sheet2!B2",
   "majorDimension": "ROWS",
   "values": [
    [
     "ThisIsB2"
    ]
   ]
  },
  {
   "range": "Sheet2!A3",
   "majorDimension": "ROWS",
   "values": [
    [
     "ThisIsA3"
    ]
   ]
  },
  {
   "range": "Sheet2!B4",
   "majorDimension": "ROWS",
   "values": [
    [
     "ThisIsB4"
```

# Set cell values

Source: https://github.com/bayselonarrend/openintegrations/blob/main/docs/en/md/GoogleSheets/Data-management/Set-cell-values.mdx

sidebar_position: 1

description: Set cell values and other functions to work with GoogleSheets in the Open Integration Package, a free open-source integration library for 1C:Enterprise 8, OneScript and CLI
keywords: [1C, 1С, 1С:Enterprise, 1С:Enterprise 8.3, API, Integration, Services, Exchange, OneScript, CLI, GoogleSheets]

# Set cell values
 Sets sheet cell values

`Function SetCellValues(Val Token, Val Spreadsheet, Val ValueMapping, Val Sheet = "", Val MajorDimension = "COLUMNS") Export`

  | Token | --token | String | &#x2714; | Token |
  | Spreadsheet | --spreadsheet | String | &#x2714; | SpreadsheetID |
  | ValueMapping | --data | Map Of KeyAndValue | &#x2714; | Fill data where the key is the cell name like A1 |
  | Sheet | --sheetname | String | &#x2716; | Sheet name (first sheet by default) |
  | MajorDimension | --dim | String | &#x2716; | Main dimension when filling the array range |

 Map Of KeyAndValue - serialized JSON response from Google
  

```bsl title="1C:Enterprise/OneScript code example"
    Token       = "ya29.a0AT3oNZ89Gfvy6_DUg_tviJJnmBXSmGRrPL6Vym5gPCsPQEa3F606plSWJttyabLz5gHJY63An6XG9wKNlbVK4fkTSF_KNhqT5M6IGUm8THO6IWF0iGzg5z2SO...";
    Spreadsheet = "1hAKnTEvhiX-_-fYfXXYthJ3xq6Ub4SrlLPaIg0Tb9fs";
    Sheet       = "Sheet2";

    ValueMapping = New Map;
    ValueMapping.Insert("A1", "ThisIsA1");
    ValueMapping.Insert("A2", "ThisIsA2");
    ValueMapping.Insert("B2", "ThisIsB2");
    ValueMapping.Insert("B3", "ThisIsB3");
    ValueMapping.Insert("A3", "ThisIsA3");
    ValueMapping.Insert("A4", "ThisIsA4");
    ValueMapping.Insert("B1", "ThisIsB1");
    ValueMapping.Insert("B4", "ThisIsB4");

    Result = OPI_GoogleSheets.SetCellValues(Token, Spreadsheet, ValueMapping, Sheet);
```
 

  
        ```bash
            # JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gsheets SetCellValues \
              --token "***" \
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" \
              --data "{'A1':'ThisIsA1','A2':'ThisIsA2','B2':'ThisIsB2','B3':'ThisIsB3','A3':'ThisIsA3','A4':'ThisIsA4','B1':'ThisIsB1','B4':'ThisIsB4'}" \
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```
  
        ```batch
            :: JSON data can also be passed as a path to a .json file
            
            oint gsheets SetCellValues ^
              --token "***" ^
              --spreadsheet "132O6J4iJfHKTSom3w3FYN9nvqLWz7oLf8a4dBW_pwJg" ^
              --data "{'A1':'ThisIsA1','A2':'ThisIsA2','B2':'ThisIsB2','B3':'ThisIsB3','A3':'ThisIsA3','A4':'ThisIsA4','B1':'ThisIsB1','B4':'ThisIsB4'}" ^
              --sheetname "Sheet2"
        ```
